modeling_decisions: Coal recess is real depth behind two host volumes. Unequal x/depth cleat block outlines, staggered terminating cross cuts, irregular chipped fronts; do not turn bedding-plane butt cleats into uniform horizontal brick courses. Concept has too many masonry-like horizontal coal splits; remove regular horizontal grid in geometry. No copied source pixels or regular decorative blocks.
repair_decisions: r001 exact8 inspected: coal blocks leave see-through gaps at host contacts and are too regular pillar-like. Extend actual coal into host beds, add solid inset core behind cleats so no through-sky slots, and create chipped uneven column fronts with irregular shorter terminating butt cleats. Increase actual host surface faceting, no paint-only fixes or camera/depth changes.
